Name: Hotho Harlaw
Quirks: speaks with Iron Islands bluntness sharpened by a lifetime of people underestimating him
his hump is something he addresses directly rather than dancing around
is more politically shrewd than he appears
CharacterDescription: Hotho Harlaw known as Hotho Humpback for the curvature of his spine is the master of the Tower of Glimmering on Harlaw and a member of the Harlaw family. The hump on his back is the first thing most people notice and the last thing Hotho allows to define him - he has compensated in the typical Ironborn way by being exceptionally capable. He has a daughter Harriet who has recently come of age. He is navigating the question of her marriage with the calculating attention of a man who knows that daughters are political currency even in the Iron Islands.
AIGeneratedBackstory: Hotho Harlaw, known as Hotho Humpback, is a member of House Harlaw and the master of the Tower of Glimmering. He has a daughter.
AdditionalContext: Campaign context: At the Tower of Glimmering on Harlaw.
